interpreted_intent: Create one independently authored, complex photorealistic test case that makes a keyword-driven scene visibly auditable: an orbital greenhouse pollination failure, one unmistakably adult woman visually informed by the supplied appearance reference, an unobscured face, and her complete hair arrangement available for later semantic evaluation without preselecting a hairstyle, hair color technique, or wetness state.

setting: A transparent rotating greenhouse module in orbit, dense with flowering vanilla vines and Earth visible beyond the glass
event: After a pollinator drone fails, the botanist manually transfers pollen between open vanilla blossoms with a charged botanical brush as the emergency alarm activates.
visual_priorities: Unmistakable hand-to-flower emergency pollination action with visible failure evidence
An unobscured reference-informed adult face and the complete hair arrangement clearly readable

baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic documentary image of one unmistakably adult female orbital botanist inside a transparent rotating greenhouse module during an orbital greenhouse pollination emergency. Visually inform her refined oval face, clear light complexion, warm brown almond-shaped eyes, straight soft brows, slim nose, and softly full lips from the supplied appearance reference. Her face is unobscured, and the complete arrangement of her hair is fully readable. A pollinator drone has failed above a wall of flowering vanilla vines; she manually transfers bright golden pollen between open blossoms with a charged botanical brush while amber alarm glyphs pulse, loose pollen grains drift, and Earth arcs beyond the glass. Prioritize unmistakable hand-to-flower pollination action, clear emergency evidence, faithful adult facial resemblance, and complete hair readability amid dense believable orbital horticulture.
